title: Algebraic-Grade Completion, Exceptional Transfer Geometry, and Functional-Equation Grade Bridge

exceptional_transfer_geometry.set_definition: S_tau = { alpha in A_R : (2*pi)^alpha in AlgebraicNumbers }

closure_properties.addition: tau^(alpha + beta) = tau^alpha * tau^beta in AlgebraicNumbers
closure_properties.rational_scaling: (tau^alpha)^(m/n) is root of X^n - (tau^alpha)^m = 0, positive real root is algebraic

exceptional_transfer_geometry.rational_intersection: S_tau ∩ Q = {0} by Lindemann (1882) transcendence of pi

dimension_bound.mechanism: If alpha, beta in S_tau \ {0}, gamma = tau^alpha in Q_bar\{0,1}, then gamma^(beta/alpha) = tau^beta in Q_bar forces beta/alpha in Q

dichotomy: Case 2: S_tau = Q * alpha_* for a single algebraic irrational direction
exceptional_transfer_geometry.two_direction_impossibility: If K1-J1 and K2-J2 in S_tau \ {0}, then (K1-J1)/(K2-J2) in Q

grid_collision_structure.algebraic_transfer_criterion: V_K = V_J <=> K - J in S_tau <=> exists a, b in Q_bar* : a*tau^K = b*tau^J

integer_grid_collision.criterion: L_K ∩ L_J != empty <=> tau^(K-J) in Q_{>0}
integer_grid_collision.subgrid_generation: If tau^(K-J) = a/b in lowest positive terms, L_K ∩ L_J = { b*t*tau^K : t in Z \ {0} } = { a*t*tau^J : t in Z \ {0} } (infinite common subgrid)

prime_grid_collision.proof: p1*tau^K = q1*tau^J and p2*tau^K = q2*tau^J implies q1*p2 = q2*p1. For rational primes, unique factorization forces p1 = p2 and q1 = q2.

literature_audit.gelfond_schneider_scope: Does not apply to (2*pi)^alpha because base 2*pi is transcendental
literature_audit.lindemann_weierstrass_scope: Applies to algebraic exponents of e, not powers of pi
literature_audit.four_exponentials_conjecture: Consistent with dim_Q S_tau <= 1, but does not prove S_tau = {0}

canonical_grid_zeta.same_zero_set_theorem: For all K in A_R and s in C, tau^(-K*s) != 0, so Z_K(s) = 0 <=> zeta(s) = 0
canonical_grid_zeta.analytic_pullback_distinction: zeta(tau^(-K)*s) is strictly classified as ANALYTIC_PULLBACK and not arithmetic TC

local_zero_germ.proof_status: VALID_DETECTOR_NOT_PROOF (grade-invariance of germ modulus assumes delta == 0)

special_value_exact_relations.nature: Exact rational relation connecting Grade 1 at 2n with Grade 0 at 1-2n via functional equation period transfer

task_tc_022_audit.prior_statement: No cross-grade algebraic relation exists between zeta realizations
task_tc_022_audit.reconciliation: NARROWED: At identical argument s, Z_K(s)/Z_J(s) is transcendental for generic s. Under reflection s <-> 1-s, the functional equation transfers the period tau^(2n) exactly, yielding an authentic rational relation at special integer values.

three_grade_experiment.setup: K0, K1, K2 in A_R with (K1-K0)/(K2-K0) not in Q
three_grade_experiment.reason: At nontrivial zeros, values vanish identically (0=0), and local zero germ ratios involve transcendental non-algebraic factors without independent algebraic relations
